ios.desc:
Waiting is better together. Turn every date you can't wait for—weddings, trips, birthdays, reunions—into a countdown you share, with widgets you'll both smile at every day.

Use Outside for trips, birthdays, weddings, anniversaries, reunions, concerts and every date worth looking forward to.

CREATE AND SHARE
Create a countdown, send an invite and let friends, family or your partner join the same moment.

WIDGETS AT A GLANCE
Keep your next countdown on your Home Screen, Lock Screen or in StandBy.

PLAN TOGETHER
Add the date, place and details so everyone knows what is happening.

FREE TO START
The free plan includes creating, sharing and joining countdowns, plus Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy widgets.

OUTSIDE PRO
Outside Pro is optional and adds custom reminders, calendar sync, recurring events, attachments, camera-roll wallpapers, group chat, custom app icons, photo uploads and search, premium countdown styles, links and checklists.

Available plans, prices and introductory trial eligibility are shown before purchase.

Support: https://outside.so/support
